title: Energising Parry - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Energising Parry in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Forgotten Battlefield; Sacred River merchant; Renoir's Drafts merchant

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Energising Parry is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: +1 AP on a successful Parry.

sections.title: How to Get Energising Parry
sections.content: Location: Forgotten Battlefield; Sacred River merchant; Renoir's Drafts merchant.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
